note: lib/run.py config (SMB1): RAM shown after every step, the level/map expressions, progress and the lives byte. SMB1 has no map.
map_note: SMB1 has no world map; on_map is always false. in_level means normal play (mode 01), which is true for the whole run except the title and game-over screens.

advance.note: no finale bytes: chapters use --goal until (the stage byte $075C changes), which do_step reports as GOAL
advance.goal_note: chapter goal: --goal until --until '[$075C] == N && [$0772] == 3' (N = next stage, 0-based; world byte $075F for x-4)
